name: smwmusic-the-legend-of-the-mystical-ninja-oedo-goemon-s-home
title: The Legend of the Mystical Ninja - Oedo ~ Goemon's Home
description:
The happy song from the first level of this fun game. Very eastern sounding with extra Konami flavour.

Isn't it great how the woodblock instrument sounds like a huge drum at a low pitch?

Edit: Fixed the issue with the flutes. Big thanks to brickblock369 for helping out.
